hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(rm\s+-rf\s*/|rm\s+-rf\s*\.\.|DROP\s+TABLE|git\s+push\s+--force[^-]|sudo\s+rm)' && printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Destructive command blocked — confirm with user before proceeding."}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.|\.pem$|\.key$|credentials\.json$|\.secret)' && printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ Accessing sensitive file — verify no secrets will be committed."}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE '(tsconfig.*\.json$|vite\.config\.(ts|js)$|tailwind\.config\.(js|ts)$|pnpm-workspace\.yaml$)' && printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Modification of build/compiler config blocked — confirm with user before changing tsconfig, vite.config, tailwind.config, or pnpm-workspace."}' || true
